findings.claim: SEMI 2025-12 預測：總設備銷售 2026 $145B、2027 $156B；成長主要來自 AI 相關支出，中國產能擴建亦有貢獻。
findings.source: SEMI press release: Global Semiconductor Equipment Sales Projected to Reach a Record of $156 Billion in 2027

findings.claim: SEMI 2026-04：300mm 晶圓廠設備支出 2027 年首度突破 $150B；2027–2029 記憶體設備支出累計 $175B（DRAM $111B、3D NAND $62B），邏輯/微元件 $228B；SEMI 稱持續高投資應有助緩衝傳統記憶體週期下行。
findings.source: SEMI press release: SEMI Projects Double-Digit Growth in Global 300mm Fab Equipment Spending for 2026 and 2027
